findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 76 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric artery, celiac artery, and common hepatic artery, suggesting invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in one node at station 1 and four nodes at station 9. A contrast-enhancing mass is observed in the right cerebellar hemisphere, raising suspicion of brain metastasis.
